core_meaning.short_meaning: Of praise, belonging to praise; my praise
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hamdi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Of praise, belonging to praise; my praise”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hamdi corresponds to the Arabic form حمدي (Arabic root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); حَمْدِي (Ḥamdī)). Its core sense is one who praises, praiser. Hamdi is Arabic حَمْدِي (Ḥamdī) 'of praise, belonging to praise; my praise', a nisba-style formation from حَمْد (ḥamd), root ح م د (ḥ-m-d). The source gloss 'praiser' is a reasonable rendering.
